criteria: C2 palette at last frame: >=55% pixels within L1<=40 of #f8f8f8; >=8% within L1<=60 of #784828 or #885828

C4 ease: largest |dscale| frame in middle third of the run; first and last run frames |dscale| < 0.6*peak
C5 static outside: frames 1-19 and 45-end have |dscale|<0.003 and |dx|<2 (camera)
C6 visual (orchestrator, render frames only): hand-drawn outline style, handwritten labels, bracket-left-of-figure layout, original characters — each PASS/FAIL
measurement: deterministic C1-C5 by scripts/evaluate_style_rt.py on rendered pixels; C6 visual by orchestrator on render frames only; overall PASS only if all C1-C6 PASS
scope: style + full-scene (characters, background, typography, layout, motion) for one bounded scene; font/software UNKNOWN; sound NOT tested
